environment.description: Deployed on the same GKE cluster but fronted by Google Cloud Armor security policy 'inv-api-policy' attached to a Global External Application Load Balancer (GXLB). The policy has two rules evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 1000: preconfiguredWafRules with expression evaluatePreconfiguredExpr('sqli-v33-stable') applied to action 'deny(403)' on all paths matching '/api/v1/products/search*'; (2) Priority 2000: preconfiguredWafRules with expression evaluatePreconfiguredExpr('xss-v33-stable') applied to action 'deny(403)' on all paths. Default rule at priority 2147483647 allows. Additionally, the GKE service has a BackendConfig annotation specifying securityPolicy: 'inv-api-policy'. The GXLB terminates TLS and forwards to a NEG targeting the Flask pods directly (no nginx ingress in this path).

config.load_balancer: Google Cloud Global External Application Load Balancer
